Title: Mimicry in Snakes
Content: Mimicry is an evolved resemblance between `text(two)` species. The harmless scarlet king snake mimics the Eastern coral snake. The king snake has evolved red, yellow, and black bands that make it look very similar to the venomous coral snake. In some areas, both snakes are found together and consume some of the same organisms for food.
